fact: The encounter takes place on the fifteenth day of their voyage.
source_quote: On the fifteenth day of their voyage
subject: travel duration

fact: The subterranean waterway is quiet with the sound of paddles lapping against dark water.
source_quote: eerie quiet of the subterranean waterway, the sound of paddles lapping against the dark water
subject: subterranean waterway

fact: Blind cavefish drift near the surface and occasionally bump against the hull of the boat.
source_quote: Blind cavefish drifted mindlessly near the surface, occasionally bumping against the hull of the boat
subject: blind cavefish

fact: The tunnel forks around a diamond-shaped limestone islet that is forty feet wide.
source_quote: diamond-shaped limestone islet, forty feet wide
subject: limestone islet

fact: The islet features jagged stalagmites jutting upward from the water like broken teeth.
source_quote: jagged stalagmites jutting upward from the water like broken teeth
subject: The Bone Pyramid Islet

fact: There is a pyramid of bones on the islet that is eight feet high and five feet wide at its base.
source_quote: pyramid of bones, eight feet high and five feet wide at its base
subject: bone pyramid

fact: The bone pyramid is crowned with a great horned ram skull.
source_quote: crowned with a great horned ram skull
subject: horned ram skull

fact: The ram skull's empty sockets are positioned to stare directly at the travelers.
source_quote: carefully positioned so its empty sockets stared directly at them
subject: horned ram skull

fact: Brannum Redmarch panics upon seeing the bone pyramid.
source_quote: Brannum Redmarch took one look at it and panicked
subject: Brannum's reaction

fact: Brannum Redmarch shouts for the party to dock or do something.
source_quote: shouting "shit, dock! Do something!"
subject: Brannum Redmarch

fact: Brannum Redmarch admits that taking this route was a mistake.
source_quote: admitting "this was a mistake. I thought we were going the other way"
subject: Brannum Redmarch

fact: A violent beam of lightning erupts from behind a stalactite above the islet.
source_quote: a violent beam of lightning erupted from behind a stalactite above the islet
subject: lightning strike

fact: The lightning beam tries to hole the boat.
source_quote: tried to put a hole in their boat
subject: lightning strike

fact: The party makes a group check to keep the vessel from taking on water.
source_quote: The party made a group check to keep the vessel from taking on water
subject: group check

fact: The party's quick reflexes keep the boat seaworthy with only some damage.
source_quote: their quick reflexes kept the boat seaworthy with only some damage
subject: boat damage

fact: A ten-foot floating sphere of rotting flesh and dead eyes rises from behind a great stalactite.
source_quote: rising from behind the great stalactite, a ten-foot floating sphere of rotting flesh and dead eyes
subject: beholder zombie

fact: The beholder zombie drifts toward the party.
source_quote: drifted toward them: a beholder zombie
subject: beholder zombie

fact: The beholder zombie is drawn by the commotion and is hungry for destruction.
source_quote: drawn by the commotion and hungry for destruction
subject: beholder zombie

fact: Gyrgum casts Command and orders the beholder zombie to flee.
source_quote: Gyrgum cast Command and ordered the creature to flee
subject: Gyrgum's Command

fact: Gyrgum realizes the beholder zombie does not understand what he says.
source_quote: only to realize with a sinking feeling that the undead horror understood nothing he said
subject: Command failure

fact: Thorin starts rowing away.
source_quote: Thorin starts rowing away
subject: Thorin

fact: Thorin trusts that Brannum Redmarch knows what he is talking about.
source_quote: trusting that Brannum knows what he is talking about
subject: Thorin

fact: It is unclear whether the lightning came from the beholder zombie or from a second source.
source_quote: It is unclear whether the lightning came from the zombie or from a second source
subject: lightning source
